import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { CONFIRM_KEYWORD, EMPTY_STRING, FIRST_ARG_INDEX, MIN_SKILL_BOOK_ID, SECOND_ARG_INDEX } from '@src/constants';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import App from '@src/response-apps/skillBook/learn/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

/**
 * 学习功法指令处理器
 * 指令格式: /学习功法 {物品ID}
 */
const response = onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  const uid = e.uid as number;

  // 解析命令参数（移除命令前缀）
  const messageText = (e.MessageText || EMPTY_STRING).replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?学习功法\s*/, EMPTY_STRING).trim();
  const args = messageText ? messageText.split(/\s+/) : [];
  const skillBookIdStr = args[FIRST_ARG_INDEX];
  const confirmArg = args[SECOND_ARG_INDEX];

  // 验证物品ID参数
  if (!skillBookIdStr || skillBookIdStr === EMPTY_STRING) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('❌ 参数错误');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('使用方法:');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('/学习功法 [物品ID]');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('示例:');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('/学习功法 123   ← 学习储物袋中ID为123的功法');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('💡物品ID为储物袋中功法的编号');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('💡功法获得后可直接查看词条和学习');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const skillBookId = parseInt(skillBookIdStr, 10);

  if (isNaN(skillBookId) || skillBookId < MIN_SKILL_BOOK_ID) {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('❌ 参数错误');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('物品ID必须是大于0的数字');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('示例:');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('/学习功法 123   ← 学习储物袋中ID为123的功法');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  // 调用数据层
  const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);
  const forceReplace = confirmArg === CONFIRM_KEYWORD;
  const result = await App({ messageText: e.MessageText, bid, uid, skillBookId, forceReplace, request });

  switch (result.code) {
    case 'NO_SKILL_BOOKS': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('储物袋中没有功法');
      md.addNewline();

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '❌', content: md, footer: [{ label: '储物袋', command: '/我的储物袋 功法' }] }));

      return;
    }

    case 'NOT_FOUND': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('❌ 物品ID错误');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(result.data.message);
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('💡请使用 /我的储物袋 功法 查看功法ID');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    case 'UNIDENTIFIED': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('❌ 学习失败');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(result.data.message);
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText('💡请重新打开功法背包，再尝试学习');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    case 'LOCKED': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('❌ 学习失败');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(result.data.message);
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(`💡请先使用 /解锁 功法 ${result.data.skillBookId} 解锁后再学习`);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    case 'NEED_CONFIRM': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(`⚠️ ${result.data.message}`);

      md.addNewline();

      void message.send(
        FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: [{ label: '确认替换', command: `/学习功法 ${result.data.actualSkillBookId} 确认` }] })
      );

      return;
    }

    case 'FAILED': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      const displayMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, result.data.message, request);

      md.addText('❌ 学习失败');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(displayMsg);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    case 'LOAD_FAILED': {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(result.data.message);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    case 'OK': {
      const { result: learnResult } = result.data;

      // 构建成功消息
      let successMessage = `✅ 学习成功

【${learnResult.skillBook?.name}】
类型: ${learnResult.skillBook?.skillType}`;

      // 如果是替换，添加替换提示和返还残页信息
      if (learnResult.replaced && learnResult.refundInfo) {
        successMessage += '\n\n已替换旧功法';

        // 返还详情
        const refundInfo = learnResult.refundInfo;

        successMessage += `\n熟练度继承: ${refundInfo.transferredProficiency}%`;

        successMessage += `\n\n📦 折算经验: ${refundInfo.totalExp}`;
        successMessage += `\n├─ 基础返还: ${refundInfo.baseExp}`;

        if (refundInfo.upgradeCount > 0) {
          successMessage += `\n└─ 升级经验: ${refundInfo.upgradeExp} (${refundInfo.upgradeCount}次升级)`;
        }

        // 返还的功法残页
        if (refundInfo.items && refundInfo.items.length > 0) {
          successMessage += '\n\n获得功法残页:';
          refundInfo.items.forEach((item: any) => {
            successMessage += `\n  • ${item.name} x${item.quantity} (${item.expValue}经验/个)`;
          });
        }
      }

      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(successMessage);

      md.addNewline();

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: [{ label: '我的功法', command: '/我的功法' }] }));
    }
  }
});

export default response;
